summary.claim_scope: displayed identities any n>=2 by free cancellation; neighbourhood n=2..7

statement: For n>=2 the four displayed freely reduced products D·B, B·D, D·B^{-1}, B·D^{-1} satisfy: each listed associated-subgroup rewrite returns a cyclic conjugate of D or D^{-1}. This is equality modulo B (a BS/Britton preflight), not an AC1–AC5 move. For n=2..7, every valid pinch occurrence on both rows of every canon_pair-unique depth-1 AC2 child rewrites to cyclic D, D^{-1}, B, B^{-1}, or empty; empty occurs only on the B slot.
notes: The associated-subgroup rewrite is not an AC1–AC5 move.
A valid pinch on D·B that is B's own BS pinch is not a C5 finish.
Uniqueness is canon_pair (cyclic/inverse of each row, then slot order).
No-pinch children are serialized with lengths; they keep D.
Whitehead Aut / generator swap are C1 and are not expanded.
Incoming C16 still has two Lemma-11 uses. Not a U124 solve.
